shared_elements: figures shown in a horizontal register/frieze
stylized surface detailing of hair and beard in rows of curls
justification: Both show low-relief bearded men in profile arranged along a horizontal band, with hair and beards rendered as regular rows of curls and figures carrying weapons, which is a fairly specific shared convention. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A is a static ceremonial procession of standing robed dignitaries with a rosette border above and below, while B is a crowded, dynamic battle/hunt scene with galloping horses, chariot wheels, fallen nude figures, animals and water or ground swirls filling the field.
